name: rcore_app
description: Frappe compose template for the deliveryplatform docker product (composes an app named rcore)

modules.name: gateways
modules._comment: Replaces the retired 'pay' entry (../pay/payments/frappe no longer carries a frappe module or manifest.json): pay's payments/frappe content moved into the gateways and wallet modules, so this template mirrors rcore.json's wallet+gateways pair.

modules.name: erp
modules._comment: ERPNext v16 fork flattened into one composed module (fork of frappe/erpnext via Frappenize/erpnext@rokct-hotfix); upstream crm/projects/support are excluded and resolve to the productivity repo's SDK modules. Composed here because the 'projects' entry below REQUIRES it (projects/frappe/manifest.json: Task extends the ERPNext Task doctype and imports erp helpers; erp calls back into {app_name}.projects.*) and compose_backend.py composes exactly the listed modules with no dependency pull-in - compose both or neither. A site composed with this module must NOT also have upstream erpnext installed.

modules.name: builder
modules._comment: Flutter build pipeline composed under its contract paths ({app_name}.builder.tasks._generate_flutter_app, {app_name}/builder/source_code). Source mirrors the rcore shell's committed composer.json, where builder replaced the 'dev' entry (../corporate/dev/frappe); the two cannot coexist — both ship the flutter_app_configuration / flutter_build_settings doctypes and the composer hard-fails on duplicate DocTypes.

modules.name: projects
modules._comment: Server home of the productivity_sdk Tasks screen: the six api.projects.* gateway cmds (sync_personal_task, list_personal_tasks, snooze_task_reminder, delete_personal_task, propose_task_breakdown, apply_task_breakdown) plus the Task reminder cron. Tasks are local-first on every device and sync whenever this backend is reachable, so every tenant that serves an app composing productivity_sdk composes this module the same way. Requires the erp entry above; the erp-tenant-tree import fix (productivity#32) is needed for the pair to install.

sdks.name: base_sdk
sdks._sha256_comment: SHA-256 of base/nextjs/install.py at core@573d570; required by the composer's unpinned-installer gate. Update when upstream install.py changes.

sdks.name: auth_sdk
sdks._sha256_comment: SHA-256 of auth/nextjs/install.py at users as bootstrapped; required by the composer's unpinned-installer gate. Update when upstream install.py changes.

sdks.name: telemetry_sdk
sdks._sha256_comment: SHA-256 of telemetry/nextjs/install.py at core@573d570; required by the composer's unpinned-installer gate. Update when upstream install.py changes.
sdks._comment: Mandatory in every Next.js composition (SDK_ECOSYSTEM.md hard invariant 9, mirroring the flutter templates' telemetry_sdk entries). Empty-manifest seam owner: installs nothing; base_sdk's kernel carries the TelemetryClient.
